# 下载 RunBuoy

离开电脑，也知道任务跑到哪了。

**[在 App Store 下载 RunBuoy](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/runbuoy/id6795591930)**

RunBuoy 免费下载，需要 **iOS 18 或更新版本**。带有灵动岛的机型也可以在灵动岛查看任务；其他支持的 iPhone 可以使用 App 和锁屏实时活动。

## 下载后，连接你的电脑

RunBuoy 的任务从 **macOS 或 Linux** 启动。建议通过 `uv` 安装 CLI，并准备好 `tmux`；uv 会管理所需的 Python 3.12 环境。

1. [安装并验证 CLI](/guide/)。
2. 在电脑运行 `runbuoy device pair`，用 App 扫码并确认电脑身份。
3. 主动运行 `runbuoy demo live-activity`，确认手机能收到演示状态。
4. [接入自己的命令](/guide/run)；如果需要百分比或预计完成时间，再[接入显式进度](/guide/progress)。

[查看完整配对指南](/guide/pairing)

:::info 服务区域
当前官方端到端流程使用 `Global` 服务。iPhone 只展示状态，不远程启动、停止或重试任务。首次接入需要联网。
:::

## 源码与进阶使用

- [GitHub 源码](https://github.com/Cabbyte/RunBuoy)
- [iOS 客户端源码](https://github.com/Cabbyte/RunBuoy/tree/main/apps/ios)
- [自托管配置与客户端要求](/self-hosting)

description: Get RunBuoy free on the App Store. Follow the status, progress, and results of long-running Mac and Linux tasks from your iPhone.

# Get RunBuoy

Step away. Stay in the know.

**[Download RunBuoy on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/runbuoy/id6795591930)**

RunBuoy is free to download and requires **iOS 18 or later**. Dynamic Island is available on supported models. Other supported iPhones can use the app and Lock Screen Live Activities.

## Next, connect your computer

Tasks start on **macOS or Linux**. Install the CLI on your computer with `uv` and `tmux` available. uv manages the required Python 3.12 environment.

1. [Install and verify the CLI](/en/guide/).
2. Run `runbuoy device pair` on your computer. Scan the QR code in the app and confirm the computer.
3. Run `runbuoy demo live-activity` yourself to check that the demo reaches your phone.
4. [Connect your own command](/en/guide/run). To show percentages or time estimates, [report explicit progress](/en/guide/progress).

[Read the full pairing guide](/en/guide/pairing)

:::info Service region
The official end-to-end flow currently uses the `Global` service. Your iPhone displays status; it cannot remotely start, stop, or retry a task. Initial setup requires an internet connection.
:::

## Source and advanced setup

- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Cabbyte/RunBuoy)
- [iOS client source](https://github.com/Cabbyte/RunBuoy/tree/main/apps/ios)
- [Self-hosting and client requirements](/en/self-hosting)

--- description: 使用 Agent 提示词或手动流程，在 macOS 或 Linux 上安装并验证 RunBuoy Skill 与 CLI。 --- # 快速开始 import { Tab, Tabs } from '@rspress/core/theme'; 先在 iPhone [从 App Store 下载 RunBuoy](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/runbuoy/id6795591930)（iOS 18+），再在 Mac 或 Linux 安装 CLI。你可以把下面的安装提示词交给支持 Skill 的 Agent，也可以手动执行。 完整流程是：**下载 App → 安装 CLI → 配对电脑 → 运行任务**。安装与验证完成后，继续本文末尾的手机配对与演示。
## 使用 Agent 安装（推荐） :::tip 一条提示词安装 Skill + CLI Agent 会先安装 RunBuoy Skill，再读取 Skill 自带的安全规则安装和验证 CLI。涉及 `sudo`、系统包管理器或 curl 安装器时，它必须先说明命令并等待确认。 ::: 复制下面整段提示词并粘贴给支持 Skill 的 Agent： ```text 请帮我安装并验证 RunBuoy： 1. 使用你原生支持的 Skill 安装机制，从 https://github.com/Cabbyte/RunBuoy/tree/main/skills/runbuoy 安装 RunBuoy Skill，完整保留 SKILL.md、agents/openai.yaml 和 references/ 目录，不要猜测安装路径。 2. 安装后读取该 Skill 的 references/installation.md，并按照其中的安全规则安装 RunBuoy CLI。先检查 command -v runbuoy；如果缺失且 uv 已可用，执行： uv tool install --python 3.12 runbuoy 3. 如果缺少 uv、tmux，或者需要 sudo、系统包管理器或 curl 安装器，请先说明将执行的命令并等待我的确认。 4. 最后运行： runbuoy --version runbuoy doctor --json runbuoy capabilities --json 只汇报 Skill 是否能以 $runbuoy 被发现、CLI 版本、local_ready 和 delivery 状态。不要启动配对、Demo、被监控命令，也不要上传日志。 ``` 这个流程只负责安装与验证，不会配对手机或启动任务。[了解 Agent 安装提示词的设计与使用方式](/guide/agent-skill)。
## 手动安装 CLI :::tip 手动安装 · 当前可用 下面的 uv 流程是公开、可执行的安装方式，支持 macOS 与 Linux。 ::: ### 1. 安装系统依赖与 uv ```bash brew install tmux uv uv tool update-shell ``` ```bash sudo apt update sudo apt install tmux curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv tool update-shell ``` ```bash sudo dnf install tmux curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv tool update-shell ``` ```bash sudo pacman -S tmux curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv tool update-shell ``` 重启终端后继续。uv 会自动下载并管理所需的 Python 3.12；`tmux` 是必须通过系统包管理器安装的依赖。 ### 2. 安装 CLI ```bash uv tool install --python 3.12 runbuoy ``` 根据实际使用的 Shell 选择一个补全命令： ```bash runbuoy completion install bash ``` ```bash runbuoy completion install zsh ``` ```bash runbuoy completion install fish ``` ### 3. 验证安装 ```bash runbuoy --version runbuoy doctor --json runbuoy capabilities --json ``` doctor schema v2 的 `local_ready=true` 表示平台、Python、tmux 与本地存储已满足执行条件。`delivery.ready` 是独立状态；尚未配对或 Server 不可达时，本地 Run 仍完整可用。 ## 可选：在 Python 项目中使用 API `uv tool` 创建的 CLI 环境与项目 Python 环境相互隔离。如果代码需要 `from runbuoy import progress` 等 API，请在项目根目录另行声明依赖： ```bash cd my-project uv add --optional runbuoy runbuoy uv sync --extra runbuoy ``` 这是正常的双环境安装，不是重复配置。SDK 调用必须发生在 RunBuoy 启动的目标进程树内；详见[进度模式](/guide/progress)。 ## 已经手动安装了 CLI？ 仍然可以在任何时候使用上面的 Agent 提示词补装 Skill。Agent 会先运行 `command -v runbuoy`，检测到现有 CLI 后不会重复安装，只会继续验证环境。 ## 连接手机并验证第一条动态 打开已安装的 App，完成引导。在电脑运行： ```bash runbuoy device pair ``` 用 App 扫描终端二维码，核对电脑身份并完成配对，然后主动运行一次演示： ```bash runbuoy demo live-activity ``` 确认 iPhone 收到演示状态后，将自己的命令放在 `runbuoy run --` 后启动。下面的脚本名需要替换为你自己的脚本： ```bash runbuoy run -- python3 your_task.py ``` 任务仍在电脑上运行，iPhone 只展示状态。普通命令提供运行状态与结果；百分比、阶段和预计完成时间需要任务显式报告。演示与真实任务都由你主动启动，安装提示词不会代你执行。 ## 下一步 - [完整安装、升级与卸载说明](/guide/install) - [配对更多电脑](/guide/pairing) - [运行命令与发送通知](/guide/run) - [配置真实进度](/guide/progress)

--- description: Install and verify the RunBuoy Skill and CLI on macOS or Linux with an agent prompt or the manual flow. --- # Quick Start import { Tab, Tabs } from '@rspress/core/theme'; First, [get RunBuoy on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/runbuoy/id6795591930) for your iPhone (iOS 18+). Then install the CLI on your Mac or Linux computer, using an agent or the manual steps below. The complete flow is: **get the app → install the CLI → pair your computer → start a task**. After installation, continue to the phone pairing section below.
## Install with an Agent (recommended) :::tip One prompt installs the Skill + CLI Your agent installs the RunBuoy Skill first, then reads its built-in safety rules to install and verify the CLI. It must explain the command and wait for approval before using `sudo`, a system package manager, or a curl installer. ::: Copy the complete prompt and paste it into an agent that supports Skills: ```text Help me install and verify RunBuoy: 1. Use your native Skill installation mechanism to install the RunBuoy Skill from https://github.com/Cabbyte/RunBuoy/tree/main/skills/runbuoy Preserve SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml, and the references/ directory in full. Do not guess an installation path. 2. After installation, read references/installation.md from that Skill and follow its safety rules to install the RunBuoy CLI. First check command -v runbuoy. If it is missing and uv is available, run: uv tool install --python 3.12 runbuoy 3. If uv or tmux is missing, or sudo, a system package manager, or a curl installer is required, explain the exact command and wait for my approval. 4. Finally run: runbuoy --version runbuoy doctor --json runbuoy capabilities --json Only report whether the Skill is discoverable as $runbuoy, the CLI version, local_ready, and delivery status. Do not start pairing, a demo, or any monitored command, and do not upload logs. ``` This flow only installs and verifies RunBuoy. It does not pair a phone or start a run. [Learn how the agent installation prompt is designed and used](/en/guide/agent-skill).
## Install the CLI manually :::tip Manual installation · Available now The uv flow below is a public, executable installation path for macOS and Linux. ::: ### 1. Install system dependencies and uv ```bash brew install tmux uv uv tool update-shell ``` ```bash sudo apt update sudo apt install tmux curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv tool update-shell ``` ```bash sudo dnf install tmux curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv tool update-shell ``` ```bash sudo pacman -S tmux curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv tool update-shell ``` Restart the terminal before continuing. uv downloads and manages the required Python 3.12 runtime; `tmux` is a system dependency that must come from your operating system package manager. ### 2. Install the CLI ```bash uv tool install --python 3.12 runbuoy ``` Choose the completion command for the shell you actually use: ```bash runbuoy completion install bash ``` ```bash runbuoy completion install zsh ``` ```bash runbuoy completion install fish ``` ### 3. Verify the installation ```bash runbuoy --version runbuoy doctor --json runbuoy capabilities --json ``` `local_ready=true` from doctor schema v2 confirms that the platform, Python, tmux, and local storage meet execution requirements. `delivery.ready` is separate; local Runs remain available before pairing or while the Server is unreachable. ## Optional: use the Python API in a project The CLI environment created by `uv tool` is isolated from your project environment. If your code imports APIs such as `from runbuoy import progress`, declare the dependency in the project root as well: ```bash cd my-project uv add --optional runbuoy runbuoy uv sync --extra runbuoy ``` Installing into both environments is intentional. SDK calls must run inside the process tree started by RunBuoy; see [Progress modes](/en/guide/progress). ## Already installed the CLI manually? You can use the agent prompt above later to add the Skill. The agent checks `command -v runbuoy` first, so an existing CLI is not installed again; it simply continues with verification. ## Connect your phone and see the first update Open the app and finish its introduction. On your computer, run: ```bash runbuoy device pair ``` Scan the QR code in the app and confirm the computer. Then start a demo yourself: ```bash runbuoy demo live-activity ``` Once the update reaches your iPhone, put your own command after `runbuoy run --`. Replace the script name below with your own: ```bash runbuoy run -- python3 your_task.py ``` Tasks keep running on your computer. The phone only shows status. Ordinary commands report running status and results; percentages, phases, and time estimates require explicit reports from the task. You start demos and tasks yourself; the installation prompt does not do this for you. ## Next steps - [Complete installation, upgrade, and removal guide](/en/guide/install) - [Pair more machines](/en/guide/pairing) - [Run commands and send notifications](/en/guide/run) - [Configure honest progress](/en/guide/progress)
